changelog:
Initial release of the English Learning Coach skill.

- Enables immersive English conversation practice with real-time error detection and corrections.
- Provides adjustable correction strictness (natural, exam, lenient) and output vocabulary level targeting (A1–C1), defaulting to simple English.
- Tracks user errors, maintains an error notebook, and supports active vocabulary management and CEFR level estimation.
- Supports review commands: /level, /summary, /stats, /review, /quiz.
- Outputs corrections only when strictness criteria are unmet; does not mix corrections with conversation.
- All tracking and scoring are run silently in the background for an uninterrupted user experience.
